documents.text: An abnormal stool-based colorectal screening test requires follow-up colonoscopy evaluation. This coordination application does not diagnose cancer or determine clinical eligibility. A qualified clinician reviews the source result and arranges appropriate follow-up.

FIT_POS maps to the colorectal-fit coordination pathway. Identity uncertainty and unsupported pathways enter owned quarantine. The navigation team retains episode accountability until an authorized receiver accepts an episode transfer. Delivery, acknowledgement and understanding are independent. Patient questions require a human clinician reply and agreed next action. Booking, attendance, completed investigation and reviewed outcome are independent. Completed required care needs verified investigation, reviewed outcome and patient update evidence. If onward care is required, verified treatment initiation or an accepted surveillance plan with owner and recall date is necessary. Trusted urgent flags pause routine progression pending clinician disposition. Demonstration windows: routine tasks 48 hours, consultation 24 hours, urgent staff acknowledgement 1 hour; these are operational test settings, not clinical deadlines.

Your screening result needs follow-up. Your care team will explain the next step and help arrange assessment. This screening result alone is not a diagnosis. Please acknowledge the message and complete the separate understanding check. Ask your assigned care team a question or report a timing, transport, language or other barrier. The portal notification simulator does not send real SMS or email.

documents.text: تحتاج نتيجة الفحص إلى متابعة. سيشرح لك فريق الرعاية الخطوة التالية ويساعدك في ترتيب التقييم. نتيجة الفحص وحدها ليست تشخيصاً. يرجى تأكيد استلام الرسالة والإجابة بشكل منفصل عن سؤال فهم الخطوة التالية. يمكنك طرح سؤال على فريق الرعاية أو الإبلاغ عن صعوبة في المواعيد أو المواصلات أو اللغة. هذه بيئة تجريبية ببيانات خيالية.
